glosses: peak, summit, top (the highest point of a mountain)
a high mountain that ends in a peak
top, apogee, acme (the greatest, highest, most successful or most developed point of anything)

examples.text: Eles finalmente alcançaram o pico da montanha.
examples.en: At last, they reached the top of the mountain.

examples.text: Desculpe por te incomodar nesta hora de pico.
examples.en: Sorry for bothering you at this busy time.
